events.title: Celebrating John Lennon's 'Imagine'
events.blurb: Today, we highlight John Lennon's profound album 'Imagine', which was originally released in 1971, not 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album, a masterpiece from 1971, continues to inspire with its message of peace and unity. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Musician, singer, and songwriter Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Sting! From The Police frontman to a solo superstar, his influence spans decades and genres. We're celebrating his incredible career today.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music and putting "1,000 songs in your pocket."

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed how we listened to music forever. Who remembers their first click wheel?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic British spy and over 60 years of thrilling cinema. What's your favourite Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Ahead of its Time
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Forever Missed
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the life and legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who forever changed the face of music.

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Today, we honour the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King's music still reigns supreme!

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are still as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking and captivating audiences worldwide.

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us joy and 'One Step Beyond' for decades.

events.title: Paul Young Turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals have given us some timeless classics.
